capabilities: display Obsidian activity as your Discord status
show the vault name and current file name in the status
customize which status details are shown
reconnect to Discord from the command palette
extras: Connection only works while the Discord desktop app is running; a reconnect button and command are provided otherwise. Requires Obsidian v0.9.10+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show Discord friends what you are working on inside the app.

relations.evidence: Update your Discord Status to show your friends what you are working on in Obsidian.

summary: Discord Rich Presence integration that displays your vault name and current file in your Discord status while you work.
